TOTP Generator

Paste a base32 secret to get real RFC 6238 TOTP codes with a live countdown, plus a verify mode.

Client-side only: your secret never leaves this browser tab. For real accounts, prefer your phone's authenticator app.

📖 How to use

  1. Paste your base32 TOTP secret.
  2. The current 6-digit code appears with a countdown ring.
  3. Use verify mode to check a code someone gives you.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which algorithm is used?

HMAC-SHA1 with a 30-second time step and dynamic truncation — exactly per RFC 6238/4226.

Can I verify a code?

Yes — enter a code to check it against the current, previous, and next 30-second window.

Does it accept spaced secrets?

Secrets often include spaces or lowercase letters; both are accepted and ignored/normalized.

Is it safe to paste my real secret?

The secret never leaves your browser — but for real accounts, prefer your phone's authenticator app.
